d:
Bihar ke purniya jile men aayojit bhartiy janta parti ki 'loktantr bachao, arajakta hatao' padyatra ke dauran asam ke mukhyamantri himant bisva sarma ne kangres neta rahul gandhi par tikha hamla bola.
Rahul gandhi ke bayanon aur sanskriti ki samajh par saval uthate hue himant bisva sarma ne kaha, "log vailentain de par tohphe dete hain. kya koee divali par gulab deta hai? rahul gandhi ko bilkul bhi jankari nahin hai ki hamare bharat ki sanskriti kya hai."
